title: Days Reached by a Settled Change, TRICARE Reserve Select Reserve Select Closing Reconciliation
content:
**Ledger adjustment ruling - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select, Reserve Select closing reconciliation.**

Which counted days of the monthly bill that change applies to follows the period it covers: where the change credit or paid adjustment covers only part of the month, it is spread over the days it covers and applies to the counted days from the first day it covers; where it covers the whole month, it is spread over every day of the month and applies to every counted day; otherwise it applies to no counted day.

- Spreading the change over a number of days means dividing it by that number; the change applies at that daily figure once for each counted day it reaches.
- A change covering part of a month covers the days from the DEERS event date through the last day of that month; the days it covers are the coverage days it shows.
- The counted days of the monthly bill run from its first counted day through the last day of the month.

## Worked cases (hypothetical, June, 30 days, change of 88.24)

| Counted days | Change covers | Daily figure | Counted days reached | Change applied |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 to 30 June | 20 to 30 June, 11 days | 8.0218 | 11 | 88.24 |
| 25 to 30 June | 20 to 30 June, 11 days | 8.0218 | 6 | 48.1309 |
| 15 to 30 June | whole month, 30 days | 2.9413 | 16 | 47.0613 |
